title: thread.json
description: Thread-level metadata. Lives at threads/<thread-id>/thread.json. See mad.council.a2a.md §7.4.

verdict_ref.description: Relative path to verdict.json if reviewed.

run_id_root.description: run_id of the first message; inherited by replies per wiki/patterns/run-id-correlation.md.

first_seq.description: Sequence number of the first message in this thread. Written by council-post on thread creation.

last_seq.description: Sequence number of the most recent message. Updated by council-post on each append.

message_count.description: Count of messages in threads/<id>/messages/. Updated by council-post.

last_msg_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the most recent message. Updated by council-post.

title.description: Human-readable title passed via --new-thread. Optional; most threads identify by thread_id alone.
